system.description:
At will, you extend your senses beyond human norms — eyesight and hearing sharpen to twice their mortal limits, and touch, smell and taste grow acute enough to pick out tiny details: a hidden foe's breath, a trace of poison in vitae, a handwritten note read by touch, incense burned hours ago. You may sharpen any or all senses as desired, and sometimes gain flashes of preternatural insight or warning of danger.

The power is always available and needs no challenge. However, an overwhelming stimulus — a gunshot, a flash of light — can overload a heightened sense: you are stunned for one turn and lose that sense for the rest of the scene, unless you expend a Willpower Trait to keep your wits about you.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
